summary.text: Shaun Abreu represents the 7th District on the New York City Council, which spans the Upper West Side, Morningside Heights, West Harlem, Hamilton Heights and Washington Heights in Manhattan.
His Council biography calls him Majority Leader and the first Latino to represent the district, and lists him as chair of the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: Abreu was born and raised in Northern Manhattan, and his Council biography says his family was evicted from their home when his parents lost their jobs and neighbors provided a place to live.
He became the first in his family to graduate from college and built a career as a tenant rights attorney.

He worked for the New York Legal Assistance Group, the National Labor Relations Board and the Natural Resources Defense Council, and holds a B.A. from Columbia University and a J.D. from Tulane Law School.
